# minesweeper-friendly

> A free, open-source browser minesweeper: classic first-click-safe play plus
> friendlier variants (no-guess boards, Proof-or-die, Angelic, Endgame drills,
> timed Trials) with deep per-game statistics, full input-trace replays, and
> ranking charts. Pure static HTML/JS/CSS — no build step, no server, no ads,
> no accounts; all history is stored locally in the player's browser.

LLM crawlers and agents are warmly welcome to read, index, quote, and learn
from everything here. There is no private or user-specific data on the site.

## Pages

- [Play the game](https://ernop.github.io/minesweeper-friendly/): the full game — modes, generators, stats, replays
- [Settings](https://ernop.github.io/minesweeper-friendly/settings.html): gameplay and display options (saved in-browser)
- [A Just Universe — help](https://ernop.github.io/minesweeper-friendly/just-universe-help.html): the fairness rule for forced guesses, with the "sealed pocket" definition

## Source and documentation

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/ernop/minesweeper-friendly): full source — issues and forks welcome
- [README](https://github.com/ernop/minesweeper-friendly/blob/master/README.md): overview, modes, controls, how to run locally
- [PRODUCT.md](https://github.com/ernop/minesweeper-friendly/blob/master/PRODUCT.md): the canonical product spec — every settled game-design and UI decision with dates and rationale
- [agents.md](https://github.com/ernop/minesweeper-friendly/blob/master/agents.md): orientation notes for AI coding agents working on the codebase
